title: Cassidy v. Daily Mirror Newspapers Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Cassidy v. Daily Mirror Newspapers Ltd., [1929] 2 KB 331 (Court of Appeal)
content.holding: Held that publication of an apparently innocent photograph of a man and woman announcing their engagement was actionable in innuendo by the man’s lawful wife, because acquaintances would reasonably infer she was living with him as an unmarried mistress.
content.relevance: The leading common law authority on the doctrine of Innuendo in defamation.
